answers.answer:
Pea protein in the HMI library has 18 reported results for lead, cadmium, total mercury, nickel, chromium and tin from 2 sources.

What heavy metals are found in pea protein? The library reports lead, cadmium, total mercury, nickel, chromium and tin in pea protein, most often lead, cadmium and total mercury.

Are there legal limits for heavy metals in pea protein? The EU sets a maximum of 100 µg/kg cadmium for proteins from pulses (as set for that ingredient row). It sets 1,000 µg/kg cadmium for food supplements (as placed on the market, when the product is sold as a food supplement).
